newsitem.title: UK: BS to buy UK's Firsteel for 26.6 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: BS to buy UK's Firsteel for 26.6 mln stg.

text.p: British Steel Plc said on Monday it had agreed to buy the Firsteel Group of Companies for about 17 million stg for the equity and another 9.6 million stg for the redemption of preference shares.
In a statement, British Steel said the deal would provide it with extra British narrow strip capacity, a narrow paint coating line and further service centre outlets.
Firsteel employs about 470 people and had turnover in the year to September 30, 1996 of 74 million stg.
BS added it believed the purchase, which is subject to regulatory clearance, would enhance its direct and indirect sales and service to customers.
Completion of the deal is expected in early April, it added.
